item.content:encoded:
After a discussion with Tech Team, the mention in SCP-5500 isn't a substantial enough mention given the length of the work as a whole, and is too much of a cameo to qualify for a tag. We're trying to be a bit more rigorous in our definition of what qualifies for a tag.

This makes the appearances of the character 4x2, and it therefore doesn't qualify for a tag. Denied.

item.title: Character Tags 2: Judgement Day
item.content:encoded:
Greetings!

We're remaking the character suggestion tag thread, as there are new guidelines for character tags.

Approval is still contingent on 5x3 as usual, however, from here on out, you will need approval from any member of the tech team, JS or higher.

Same deal as before, tell what tag you want added, link the five articles.

FAQ

Q. But why? It was so much more efficient!
A. Two reasons. Firstly, a lot of tags weren't getting O5'd. Secondly, there were some suspect characters being added.

Q. JS approving tags?! Are you mad?!
A. Yes.

Q. No seriously you can't trust those scrubs.
A. Totes can, it's a verification step. Also, like, most of the team are mods or something now.

Q. I refuse to let a JS approve my tag.
A. That's not a question, and that's very mean, please leave.

G'luck!
